const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const root=path.resolve('docs');const types={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css','.js':'text/javascript','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.json':'application/json','.md':'text/plain; charset=utf-8'};http.createServer((req,res)=>{let p=decodeURIComponent(req.url.split('?')[0]);let f=path.join(root,p);if(!f.startsWith(root)){res.writeHead(403);return res.end();}if(fs.existsSync(f)&&fs.statSync(f).isDirectory())f=path.join(f,'index.html');fs.readFile(f,(e,d)=>{if(e){if(p==='/'){res.writeHead(200,{'content-type':'text/html'});return res.end(fs.readdirSync(root).filter(n=>n.endsWith('.html')).map(n=>`${n}`).join('
'));}res.writeHead(404);return res.end('Not found');}res.writeHead(200,{'content-type':types[path.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});res.end(d);});}).listen(4455,()=>console.log('Serving docs on http://localhost:4455'));
